他帮助农民获得更多的水稻。

他从不放弃。

他有什么爱好吗？

是的，他有。

他喜欢拉小提琴。

他工作非常努力。

他非常善良。

title: Unit 7 · Lesson 1 My family get together
titleTranslate: 第七单元 · 第一课 我们一家人团聚
text:
Jenny: I have a Christmas card from Lucy.

Li Ming: Oh, Christmas is coming.

Danny: When is Christmas Day?

Jenny: It's on December 25.

Danny: What do you do at Christmas?

Jenny: My family get together.

We have a big dinner and sing Christmas songs.

Li Ming: Do you get presents?

Jenny: Yes, we do.
We get presents from family, friends and Santa.

Danny: Who's Santa?

Jenny: People say he's a kind old man.

When is Christmas Day?

It's on December 25.

What do people do at Christmas?

The family get together.

Have a good time!

Do you want to join the basketball club?
textTranslate:
珍妮： Lucy托人给我带来了一张圣诞贺卡。

李明：哦，圣诞节快到了。

丹尼：圣诞节是哪一天？

珍妮：12月25日。

丹尼：圣诞节你们做什么？

珍妮：家人团聚在一起。

我们吃一顿丰盛的晚餐，还要唱圣诞歌曲。

李明：你们会收到礼物吗？

珍妮：是的，我们会。
我们会收到家人、朋友和圣诞老人送的礼物。

丹尼：圣诞老人是谁？

珍妮：人们说他是一位善良的老人。

圣诞节是哪一天？

12月25日。

人们在圣诞节做什么？

家人团聚在一起。

祝你们玩得开心！

你想加入篮球俱乐部吗？

title: Unit 7 · Lesson 2 We visit our relatives
titleTranslate: 第七单元 · 第二课 我们去看望亲戚
text:
Li Ming: The Spring Festival is coming.

Tom: Oh, when is the Spring Festival?

Li Ming: It's usually in February, sometimes in January.

Tom: What do you do at the Spring Festival?

Danny: We clean the house.

Li Ming: And we do some shopping.

Li Ming: The family get together.

We visit our relatives and friends.

Danny: We often eat jiaozi.

We also watch fireworks.

Tom: That's interesting.

Li Ming: We'll visit my grandparents this year.
Would you like to come with us, Tom?

Tom: Thank you!
I'd love to.

At the Spring Festival, the family get together.

And people often eat jiaozi.
textTranslate:
李明：春节快到了。

汤姆：哦，春节是什么时候？

李明：通常在二月，有时也在一月。

汤姆：春节你们做什么？

丹尼：我们打扫房子。

李明：我们还去购物。

李明：家人团聚在一起。

我们看望亲戚和朋友。

丹尼：我们经常吃饺子。

我们还看烟花。

汤姆：真有意思。

李明：今年我们要去看望爷爷奶奶。
汤姆，你想和我们一起去吗？

汤姆：谢谢！
我很乐意去。

春节时，家人团聚在一起。

人们还经常吃饺子。

title: Unit 7 · Lesson 3 Happy Spring Festival!
titleTranslate: 第七单元 · 第三课 快乐的春节！
text:
Tom and Danny had a wonderful Spring Festival with Li Ming's family.
They were very excited.

Before the Spring Festival, they cleaned the house and put up the Spring Festival couplets.

On the Spring Festival Eve, they had a big dinner with Li Ming's family.
Then they watched TV and played games.
They also watched fireworks.

The next morning, they got lucky money from Li Ming's grandparents.
They visited Li Ming's relatives.
They said "Happy Spring Festival!" to everyone.

I had a lot of fun.
textTranslate:
汤姆和丹尼在李明一家度过了一个美好的春节。
他们非常兴奋。

春节前，他们打扫了房子，并贴上了春联。

除夕夜，他们和李明一家人吃了一顿丰盛的晚餐。
然后，他们看电视、做游戏。
他们还观看了烟花。

第二天早上，他们从李明的爷爷奶奶那里收到了压岁钱。
他们看望了李明的亲戚。
他们向大家说：“春节快乐！”

我玩得非常开心。

title: Unit 7 · Lesson 4 Again, please
titleTranslate: 第7单元·第4课 请再说一遍
text:
The Mid-Autumn Festival is a Chinese festival with a long history.
It's in the middle of autumn, usually in September or October.
On that day, families get together and have a big dinner.
People eat mooncakes and watch the full moon.

Parents often tell their children stories about the festival.

I want to have a new festival.

In the old days, there was a monster called Nian.
People were afraid of it.

In spring, Nian often came to the village at night and ate many animals.

One day, an old man came to the village.
He said, "Don't be afraid.
I have an idea."

He put up red couplets on the door and set off fireworks.
People followed him.

When Nian came again, it saw the red couplets and heard the fireworks.
It was scared and ran away.
Everyone was happy.

From then on, people put up red couplets and set off fireworks on that day every year.
The day was named Nian.

A new year, a new start.

I was born in the year of rabbit.
I'm a rabbit.
What about you?

I can do it well.
I can do it.

I need help.

When is the Spring Festival?

It's usually in February, sometimes in January.

My family get together.

What do you usually do at the Spring Festival?

We visit our relatives and friends.
textTranslate:
中秋节是一个历史悠久的中国传统节日。
中秋节在秋季的中间，通常在九月或十月。
那天，家人们团聚在一起，享用丰盛的晚餐。
人们吃月饼，赏满月。

父母常常给孩子们讲中秋节的故事。

我想过一个新的节日。

古时候，有一种名叫年兽的怪物。
人们都很害怕它。

春节时，年兽常常在夜里来到村庄，吃掉许多动物。

有一天，一位老人来到村里。
他说：“不要害怕。
我有一个办法。”

他在门上贴了红色对联，并燃放鞭炮。
人们跟着他一起做。

年兽再次到来时，看见红色对联，听见鞭炮声。
它被吓跑了。
大家都非常高兴。

从那以后，人们每年都在这一天贴红色对联、燃放鞭炮。
这一天便被称作年。

新的一年，新的开始。

我出生在兔年。
我是一只兔子。
你们呢？

我能做好。
我能做到。

我需要帮助。

春节是什么时候？

春节通常在二月，有时也在一月。

我的家人团聚在一起。

春节时你们通常做什么？

我们看望亲戚和朋友。

title: Unit 7 · What does Jack like?
titleTranslate: 第七单元 · 杰克喜欢什么？
text:
What Chinese traditional festivals do we have?

The Dragon Boat Festival.

The Spring Festival.

Who wants to join the Spring Festival group?

We are the Dragon Boat Festival group.
What can we put in our book?

We can put a picture of dragon boat in it.

Let's write a story of Qu Yuan here.

I can draw some zongzi here.

Look!
This is our book.
It's about the Dragon Boat Festival.
This is a story about Qu Yuan.

In the picture, people are rowing the dragon boats.
They are excited.
Look at this picture.

Ma Liang: I'm Ma Liang.
I like painting.
But I have no money for a brush.

Old Painter: Ma Liang!
This brush is for you.
You can paint pictures to help the poor.

Ma Liang: OK, thank you!

Ma Liang: Let me paint a rooster on the wall.

Farmer: It comes alive!
That's amazing!

Ma Liang: I'll paint many pictures to help the poor.

Farmer: Spring is coming.
It's time to grow crops.
But I have no money to buy an ox.
What can I do?

Ma Liang: Don't worry.
I can paint an ox for you.
Look!
This ox can help you.

Farmer: Oh, thank you!
I have an ox now!

Officer: Hey, Ma Liang!
I hear you have a magic brush.
Paint some gold for me.

Ma Liang: I won't do that.
I only paint to help the poor.

Officer: I'll put you in jail!

Ma Liang: What can I do?
What can I do?
Oh, I have an idea.

Let me paint a door on the wall.

Ma Liang: Now, I can go home and use my brush to help the poor.
textTranslate:
我们有哪些中国传统节日？

端午节。

春节。

谁想加入春节小组？

我们是端午节小组。
我们的书里可以写些什么？

我们可以在里面画一幅龙舟图。

我们在这里写一篇关于屈原的故事吧。

我可以在这里画些粽子。

看！
这是我们的书。
这本书讲的是端午节。
这是一个关于屈原的故事。

图中，人们正在划龙舟。
他们非常兴奋。
看这张照片。

马良：我是马良。
我喜欢画画。
可是我没有钱买毛笔。

老画师：马良！
这支笔送给你。
你可以画画来帮助穷人。

马良：好的，谢谢您！

马良：让我在墙上画一只公鸡吧。

农夫：它活过来了！
太了不起了！

马良：我要画很多画来帮助穷人。

农夫：春天快到了。
该种庄稼了。
可是我没有钱买一头牛。
我能做什么呢？

马良：别担心。
我可以给你画一头牛。
看！
这头牛可以帮你干活。

农夫：哦，谢谢你！
我现在有牛了！

官员：嘿，马良！
我听说你有一支神笔。
帮我涂些金漆吧。

马良：我不会这么做。
我只为帮助穷人而画画。

警官：我要把你关进监狱！

马良：我该怎么办呢？
我能做什么呢？
哦，我想到一个办法了。

让我在墙上画一扇门吧。

马良：现在，我可以回家，用我的画笔帮助穷人了。
